name: Ponte
description: Ponte serves your Jellyfin movies and shows as a Stremio addon: catalogs, metadata, streams straight from the files and external subtitles, for Stremio, Nuvio, AIOStreams and any other addon client. Each user gets a private addon link that plays as them.
overview: Your Jellyfin library as a Stremio addon

versions.changelog:
Complete release details for AIOStreams, Stremio and other clients.

- Every stream now carries structured data for AIOStreams: audio and subtitle tracks, languages, HDR, codec, source, release group, network and edition
- Stream descriptions list subtitle variants: Brazilian and European Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, forced and SDH
- External subtitles are labelled as external and follow the file being played
- Commentary tracks no longer count as audio languages
- More Dolby Vision range types, DTS:X on DTS-HD MA and more language names are recognised

AIOStreams users: add Ponte with the AIOStreams preset instead of Custom, with Name empty, to get this data.

Complete release details for AIOStreams, Stremio and other clients.

- Every stream now carries structured data for AIOStreams: audio and subtitle tracks, languages, HDR, codec, source, release group, network and edition
- Stream descriptions list subtitle variants: Brazilian and European Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, forced and SDH
- External subtitles are labelled as external and follow the file being played
- Commentary tracks no longer count as audio languages
- More Dolby Vision range types, DTS:X on DTS-HD MA and more language names are recognised

AIOStreams users: add Ponte with the AIOStreams preset instead of Custom, with Name empty, to get this data.

First release.

- Catalogs per movie/show library, Recently added and Continue watching, with search and paging
- Metadata with posters, backdrops, logos and episode lists
- Direct-play streams with range support, described for AIOStreams (resolution, codec, HDR/DV, audio, languages, size)
- External subtitles
- Private per-user addon links with reset and admin revoke
- Gelato items are never served
- Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x
